  Scenario: AC11 A provided operation answers 401, 403 or 404 instead of a result (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to the load operation with no valid credential
    When the request is sent
    Then the system answers 401 and writes no row
    Given a request to the load operation by a user without Reference data C
    When the request is sent
    Then the system answers 403 and writes no row
    Given a request to the approve operation for a version that does not exist
    When the request is sent
    Then the system answers 404 and changes nothing

  Scenario: AC12 A consumed call that fails or does not answer refuses the load whole (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case reference-data contract mock answers the list read with an error
    When "TEST-REFADM-01" loads the file "DOCTYPE-2026.11" for table "DOCUMENT_TYPE" with valid from 30 November 2026
    Then the system refuses the load with 503 and an RFC 9457 problem detail
    Then no row is written and no retention class is guessed
